claims.claim_ar: استعمال حرف التوكيد «إنَّ» للتوكيد والتحسر على صفةٍ محمودة (الذين عند ربك)، أي: التمهيد بقوة للأساس الذي سيُعرض عنهم لاحقًا.
claims.claim_en: Use of the emphatic particle 'Inna' to foreground and strongly affirm the quality of the group (those near your Lord), preparing the listener for the laudatory description that follows.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Gives strong emphasis to the described group and frames what follows as notable and certain.

claims.claim_ar: تكوين تضاد/مقابلة بين نفي الاستكبار («لا يستكبرون») والوصف الإيجابي للعبادة (التسبيح والسجود)، أي: تظهير الخضوع والتذلل مقابل الكبرياء، عبر الجمع بين النفي ثم الأفعال التعبدية.
claims.claim_en: A contrast (tibaq) is established: the negation of arrogance ('they do not show pride') is set against affirmative devotional acts (glorifying Him and prostrating), highlighting humility versus pride.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided source chunks contain the lemma 'تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ' but do not include the full immediate context of the paired positive verbs (يُسَبِّحُونَهُ، يَسْجُدُونَ) in the same chunk; the contrast is inferred from the ayah text rather than directly evidenced in the single source chunk.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Highlights the moral/spiritual polarity (humility vs pride) and extols the devotional attitude of those near God.
